# APU Center

> Commercial Trucking Auxiliary Power Units.. Owner-operators and major trucking companies.. The APU Center Technical Team
With decades of combined field experience in heavy-duty diesel mechanics and electrical systems, the APU Center team specializes in leading brands including Thermo King (Tripac/Evolution), Honda, Espar, Webasto, and Aries. Our expertise spans the entire lifecycle of auxiliary power--from initial sales and system design to complex electrical troubleshooting and complete unit refurbishment..
